Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3490-4359-5477-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.

Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.

943-1662-2203-2597-4235.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
943-1662-2203-2597-4235.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Karoo.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Karoo.
Repeat.

215-539-7704-7781.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Doc Samson
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

6006-7686-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6006-7686-7730.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6006-7686-7730.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1636-3143-7742.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-7742.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Machinesmith Automaton trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Machinesmith Automaton trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1170-1329-1414-5434.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1497-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

864-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-7621.description:
Activate the mutated Parcelbeast and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

703-3504-7149.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mercurial Pretender into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mercurial Pretender dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Mercurial Pretender enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Mercurial Pretenders into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Mercurial Pretender tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-3504-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

5147-6972-7155.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4136-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4136-4772-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-3200-5223.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-1532-2921.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

292-2445-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-2445-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

1-392-2275-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-392-2275-6282.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Repeat.
Resolve the Harnfel abilities.

Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1218-5280-5919.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{B} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {6}{U}{U}{U}{B} otherwise
1218-5280-5919.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Razorkin Needlehead +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 3.

2607-2682-4089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2607-2682-4089.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Archfiend of Despair and Glasspool Mimic trigger.
Resolve the Archfiend of Despair trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Master Biomancer has a power of five or greater.
 Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.

Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

1253-4222.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gyre Engineer.

Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Engineered Explosives from your graveyard to your hand.

Cast False Dawn by paying {1}{W}, drawing you a card.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {W}.
Kefnet's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Kefnet's Monument trigger, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {W}.
Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
